title: "Osmund J. Ritland" – portrait of Air Force officer on U-2 project (Chapter 2, p. 61)
description: Dark black-and-white portrait of a uniformed military officer, captioned "Osmund J. Ritland." The adjacent text describes Col. Ritland as one of the first Air Force officers assigned to Project OILSTONE and later deputy to Richard Bissell on the U-2 program.
